congress.note: BREAKING: US House passed a bill restricting stock trading by members of Congress — bars members, spouses, and dependent children from buying new individual stocks, requires waiting/divestment periods.

Thomas Massie quoted: "Congress is not serious. We are voting on a stock trading ban for members of Congress... BUT Republicans added voter-ID in the legislation" — implies bill may be poison-pilled / less likely to pass Senate cleanly.
